title: FIFA Transfer Windows
text: Player registrations may only be completed during the two officially designated transfer windows: the summer window (e.g. 10 June to 1 September 2023) and the winter window (1 to 31 January). A transfer announced or registered in a month outside these windows, such as November, is invalid.
source: FIFA Regulations on the Status and Transfer of Players

title: Release Clause Enforceability
text: A release clause (termination fee) is a binding contractual amount. To sign a player who has a release clause, the buying club must pay the EXACT clause amount to the player, who triggers it. A rumour that the buying club acquires the player for a normal transfer fee BELOW the clause is inconsistent with the contract.

title: One Registration Per Season
text: Under FIFA rules a player may be registered with only one club at a time and, within a single season, with a maximum of three clubs, with limits on in-season transfers. A rumour of a player simultaneously registered at two clubs is invalid.

title: Financial Fair Play / PSR
text: UEFA Financial Fair Play and the Premier League Profitability and Sustainability Rules require clubs to keep spending within defined limits. A rumour of an extreme fee plus wages that would clearly breach these limits is implausible (soft signal).

note: Gavi's 2023 Barcelona contract carried a EUR 1,000,000,000 release clause.
text: Gavi is under contract at Barcelona with a release clause of EUR 1,000,000,000 (one billion euros). Any club wishing to sign him must pay the full clause to the player.

note: Griezmann's Atletico release clause was EUR 125m.
text: Antoine Griezmann's Atletico Madrid contract included a release clause of EUR 125,000,000. He later left for free to Real Sociedad in 2024.

note: Benzema's Real Madrid clause was EUR 1,000,000,000.
text: Karim Benzema's Real Madrid contract contained a release clause of EUR 1,000,000,000. He left for Al-Ittihad in Saudi Arabia in 2023.

note: Enzo's Benfica release clause was EUR 120m, triggered by Chelsea in Jan 2023.
text: Enzo Fernandez had a EUR 120,000,000 release clause at Benfica. Chelsea triggered it in January 2023, a then British-record fee.

note: Felix's Benfica release clause was EUR 120m.
text: Joao Felix's Benfica release clause was EUR 120,000,000; Atletico Madrid paid it in 2019.

note: Dias's Benfica release clause was EUR 68m.
text: Ruben Dias had a EUR 68,000,000 release clause at Benfica; Manchester City paid it in 2020.

note: Tchouameni's Monaco release clause was EUR 80m.
text: Aurelien Tchouameni's AS Monaco contract carried a EUR 80,000,000 release clause; Real Madrid triggered it in 2022.

note: Szoboszlai's Leipzig release clause was EUR 60m.
text: Dominik Szoboszlai's RB Leipzig contract included a EUR 60,000,000 release clause; Liverpool triggered it in 2023.

note: Nkunku's Leipzig release clause was EUR 60m.
text: Christopher Nkunku's RB Leipzig release clause was EUR 60,000,000; Chelsea triggered it in 2023.

note: Mbappe had NO release clause; his PSG contract expired June 2024, making him a free agent.
text: Kylian Mbappe had no release clause at Paris Saint-Germain. His contract expired on 30 June 2024, so he left as a free agent to Real Madrid.

note: Haaland's Dortmund release clause was about EUR 60m (GBP 51m); City triggered it in 2022.
text: Erling Haaland's Borussia Dortmund contract carried a release clause of about EUR 60,000,000 (roughly GBP 51m); Manchester City triggered it in 2022.
Real Madrid announced the signing of Kylian Mbappe on a free transfer from PSG on 3 June 2024 after his contract expired.
Real Madrid signed Jude Bellingham from Borussia Dortmund for an initial GBP 88.5m in June 2023.
Bayern Munich completed the signing of Harry Kane from Tottenham for about GBP 100m in August 2023.
Arsenal signed Declan Rice from West Ham for a club-record GBP 105m in July 2023.
Chelsea signed Moises Caicedo from Brighton for a British-record GBP 115m in August 2023.
Liverpool signed Dominik Szoboszlai from RB Leipzig for GBP 60m in July 2023, activating his release clause.
Liverpool signed Alexis Mac Allister from Brighton for around GBP 35m in June 2023.
Manchester City signed Erling Haaland from Borussia Dortmund for his GBP 51m release clause in July 2022.
Lionel Messi joined Inter Miami on a free transfer from PSG in June 2023.
Cristiano Ronaldo signed for Al Nassr on a free transfer in December 2022.
Al Hilal signed Neymar from PSG for about EUR 90m in August 2023.
Victor Osimhen remained at Napoli for 2023-24 despite rumours linking him with Chelsea and PSG; he later joined Galatasaray on loan.
Mohamed Salah stayed at Liverpool through 2023-24; reports linking him with Al Hilal did not materialise.
